pkgmove safety report: example.com/fx/hub -> example.com/fx/hub/sub
Files moved: 2. Findings: 11. Errors: 0.

Why this matters: a moved package is initialised before the package that
imports it, so init() functions and package-level var initialisers in the moved
files now run before every initialiser of the source package. Review each
ERROR/HIGH/WARN item below before merging.

== HIGH: init() in moved file ==
  hub/maint.go:57: init() now runs when package sub initialises, before every var initialiser and init() of hub

== HIGH: package-level var initialiser calls package code ==
  hub/maint.go:17: computed = ... calls seed

== WARN: exported method (may newly satisfy interfaces) ==
  hub/maint.go:26: widget.count -> Count: check dynamic interface assertions that could now match; types in other packages that embed widget are not checked for shadowing or newly promoted methods

== WARN: function alias declared as a var (a wrapper would change behaviour) ==
  hub/maint.go:62: guard calls recover() directly (a wrapper would make it return nil under defer), so it is aliased as a var instead of a wrapper; the var is assignable and initialised at package init
  hub/maint.go:75: whereVia calls where, which inspects its call stack (runtime.Caller; a wrapper adds a frame), so it is aliased as a var instead of a wrapper; the var is assignable and initialised at package init

== WARN: reflect-visible type name changes (all users, not only moved files) ==
  hub/maint.go:19: hub.widget becomes sub.Widget for %T, reflect Type.String/PkgPath, gob names and messages that print type names (the alias keeps identity, not the name)
  hub/maint.go:50: hub.Pair becomes sub.Pair for %T, reflect Type.String/PkgPath, gob names and messages that print type names (the alias keeps identity, not the name)

== WARN: renamed method name appears in a template or reflection string ==
  hub/core.go:46: "{{.Count}} items" mentions Count (widget.count -> Count); templates call exported methods only
  hub/core.go:53: MethodByName("Count") (widget.count -> Count); reflect sees exported methods only

== WARN: runtime type/function names change package qualifier ==
  hub/maint.go: uses runtime.Caller: names of moved types and functions now print as sub.X instead of hub.X; functions that inspect their caller are aliased as vars, not wrappers

== WARN: staying var initialiser reads moved vars ==
  hub/core.go:36: startCount = ... reads registry, now initialised in package sub before all of hub (values set by hub initialisers or init() are no longer visible)
